claim: BOH Sungai Palas has a cantilevered ~20-foot overhanging balcony viewing deck; J.A.'s Balcony cafe plus the newer Tristan's Terrace (200 seats, 2019 expansion).

claim: BOH Sungai Palas Tea Centre opens 8:30 AM-4:30 PM with no general entrance fee; has a viewing deck and onsite cafe.
quote: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM ... generally there is no entrance fee to visit ... viewing deck, designed to offer an unrivalled view of the plantation

claim: Entry and parking are free; a ~15-minute factory tour runs roughly every 30 minutes; closed Mondays.

quote: Spanning over 465 hectares, BOH Tea Garden is the largest and oldest of BOH's tea gardens. It is the home of BOH's first tea factory which was built in the 1930's

claim: Bharat (Cameron Valley) estate sits on the main road ~2km before Tanah Rata with two roadside tea houses; one has a waterfall park, the other a larger panoramic deck.

claim: Bharat is the second-largest tea producer in Cameron Highlands; tea houses open ~9:00-17:00 with no entrance fee.
quote: Bharat is the second largest tea producer in Cameron Highlands ... generally open daily from 9:00 AM until 5:00 PM, and there is no entrance fee

claim: Mossy Forest eco-park entry: foreign adults RM30, children RM15; Malaysians RM10; open daily ~8:00-17:00.

quote: RM15-20 per person to take a jeep ... checkpoint that only allows registered jeep taxis to pass ... 300-metre elevated walkway ... advance booking is advised, particularly during peak seasons

claim: Guided Land Rover/jeep tours to the Mossy Forest are the standard way up the summit road.
quote: Mossy Forest Tours | Land Rover | Guided Tours Cameron Highlands

claim: A watchtower near the Gunung Brinchang summit gives panoramic views over Perak and Pahang, reaching the west coast on clear days.
quote: The watchtower nearby can be climbed for a magnificent view ... looking at all directions including Perak and Pahang states ... vistas stretching to the West Coast

claim: Gunung Brinchang is 2,032 m, the second-highest peak in the Cameron Highlands and the highest in Peninsular Malaysia reachable by paved road.
quote: Gunung Brinchang stands at 2,032 metres (6,667 ft) ... second-highest peak ... highest mountain in the region that can be reached by road ... highest accessible road in Peninsular Malaysia

claim: The Galleria Time Tunnel has been reported permanently closed.
